title: Ô cửa sổ
about: Round 24, the first piece in song-tau ("1. Piano + viola: Piano chơi giai điệu thưa; viola kéo những nốt trung trầm, chỉ xuất hiện cuối câu"): A minor at 60 bpm, a sparse tune (two or three notes a bar, a held note at every fourth bar), one soft deep note a chord under it, the violas drawn in only at each sentence's end; a middle section in C major, the tune in thirds where it peaks. An original tune.
